text:
Priya: Quick ask — who can scribe the debrief for candidate C-422 (frontend infra) tomorrow 11:00 PST? Need TL;DR, rubric scores, and follow-up items. Debrief timebox 40m. Please use the 'Interview Debrief v2' template and paste candidate ID. Also confirm recording consent.
Sam: I can cover — I have a hard conflict 11:30–11:50 though. Can do the first 40m if that works.
Elena: Hiring manager here — prefer a single scribe for continuity. Rubric weights I'd like to lock: Code=40, System=30, Culture=20, Comm=10. Also call out any security flags explicitly.
Marcus: I can scribe if needed. Quick Q: do we have explicit candidate consent to record? If not, please don't record.
Aisha: I can volunteer too but happy to be panelist if Marcus takes it. Link to the v2 debrief form? Also what's the scoring scale (1-5 or 1-10)?
Priya: Scale is 1-5 (1 = needs work, 5 = exceeds). Form URL: https://redwood.internal/debrief-form?template=v2 — please paste candidate id at the top. Candidate gave verbal consent on the screen; I'll forward the note to calendar invite. Timebox = 40m.
InterviewBot: Reminder scheduled — debrief runbook and template uploaded to #people-ops-runbooks and attached to the calendar invite.
Marcus: Ok I'll scribe and use the v2 template. I'll note the rubric weights and capture 'carry-forward' flags for infra familiarity.
Sam: Sounds good — if Marcus drops out last-minute I can swap in.
Aisha: Two quick asks: can we include an explicit 'open-source experience' checkbox in the form, and can scribe flag follow-ups with owner tags? I'll add those to the form comments.
Priya: Will add edit rights to the calendar for Marcus/Aisha/Sam and inline the form in the invite. Adding a short debrief agenda in the invite: 1) 5m candidate recap, 2) 25m score + notes, 3) 10m decision & follow-ups. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Marcus: Got it — will submit the form right after the call and ping the thread with action items.
Aisha: Thanks — I'll prep the quick rubric anchor bullets and paste here before the interview.
Priya: Appreciate it. If anyone needs to swap, ping here ASAP so I can update the invite.
